spendingCategories.name: Food & Dining
spendingCategories.essentialExample: Daily Campus Mess, Nutrition, Clean Drinking Water
spendingCategories.nonEssentialExample: Midnight Fast Food Delivery, Caramel Frappuccinos
spendingCategories.classificationRule: Essential baseline nutrition is a Need; restaurant markups and delivery fees are Wants.

spendingCategories.name: Transportation
spendingCategories.essentialExample: Monthly Student Metro/Bus Card, Bicycle Commuting
spendingCategories.nonEssentialExample: Ride-Hailing Surge Trips when buses are running
spendingCategories.classificationRule: Guaranteed arrival to exams and lectures is a Need; private premium transport is a Want.

spendingCategories.name: Education & Courseware
spendingCategories.essentialExample: Mandatory Textbooks, Lab Equipment, Exam Fees
spendingCategories.nonEssentialExample: Top-Tier Gaming Gear branded as Study Gear
spendingCategories.classificationRule: Direct academic graduation prerequisites are Needs.

spendingCategories.name: Entertainment & Leisure
spendingCategories.nonEssentialExample: VIP Concert Passes, Multiple Video Game Pre-orders
spendingCategories.classificationRule: Discretionary leisure upgrades are Wants to be capped within the 30% bucket.

spendingCategories.name: Shopping & Apparel
spendingCategories.classificationRule: Adequate clothing is a Need; status fashion trends are Wants.

spendingCategories.name: Utilities & Telecom
spendingCategories.essentialExample: Electricity, Dorm Water Bill, Mobile Data for Class
spendingCategories.classificationRule: Basic connectivity and utilities are Needs.

spendingCategories.name: Miscellaneous & Buffer
spendingCategories.classificationRule: Emergency health and safety is a Need; non-essential impulse items are Wants.
